_comment: Identifiers missing from the no-theme flow, covered for the text API only (EXT-08, EXT-23; docs/DECISIONS.md D-015).
include_theme_recognizers reuses a theme's recognizer by name instead of copying its regex (no duplication, no drift).

patterns.name: payment card number, same regex as Presidio 2.2.364 CreditCardRecognizer (predefined_recognizers/generic/credit_card_recognizer.py, registered for 'en' only, EXT-08); no Luhn check possible in an ad hoc recognizer: false positives accepted (doctrine 0.1), measured; score 0.6 keeps a margin above every threshold, including the code default DEFAULT_SCORE_THRESHOLD=0.5 (EXT-15)
email address with any domain, including internal ones (.local, .lan, .internal) rejected by Presidio's EmailRecognizer TLD check (EXT-23); simplified dot-atom addr-spec (RFC 5322 s.3.4.1)
